# Yaroslav Nagul

> Valuer based in Kyiv, Ukraine, in the profession since 2001. MRICS, RICS Registered Valuer and Recognised European Valuer (REV, TEGOVA). Partner, Valuation & Advisory, RSM Ukraine. He values businesses and assets in Ukraine and quantifies war-related losses for investors, lenders, auditors, courts and arbitral tribunals, reviews valuations prepared by others for auditors, and teaches CPD courses for valuers at the International Institute of Business (IIB).

Name forms: Yaroslav Nagul; Ярослав Нагул (Ukrainian); Yaroslav Nahul (alternative transliteration of the Ukrainian name). The views on this site are his own and do not necessarily reflect those of RSM Ukraine. Client names are withheld. Last updated: 2026-10-09.

**Credentials.** Public registers: RICS (https://www.rics.org/find-a-member), TEGOVA (https://tegova.org/valuers), UTO (https://uto.com.ua/en/list-of-appraisers/).

- MRICS, Chartered Valuation Surveyor (RICS), since 2010
- RICS Registered Valuer, since 2025
- Recognised European Valuer (REV), TEGOVA, awarded by UAPV, since 2019
- Certified valuer (State Property Fund of Ukraine), since 2001
- Certified valuer, expert monetary valuation of land (2007)
- On UTO's list of valuers practising under IVS (2019)

**Education and languages.** Engineering degree, non-destructive testing instruments and systems, Kyiv Polytechnic Institute (2001); degree in economics (finance and credit), Moscow State University of Economics, Statistics and Informatics (2008). Ukrainian, English and Russian.

**What he does now.** Valuation of businesses and assets in Ukraine, with reports under the International Valuation Standards (IVS), the RICS Red Book or Ukrainian national valuation standards, depending on who will rely on the report; assessment of war damage and lost profits (since 2022); valuation of trademarks, patents and software (since 2011); court-appointed valuation; review of valuations prepared by others for auditors, in line with ISA 540 (Revised) and ISA 620. Valuation engagements are contracted through RSM Ukraine. His track record also includes collateral valuation for international banks, IFRS revaluations and impairment testing, and financial modelling.

**Teaching.** Since 2025, lecturer at the International Institute of Business (IIB) on CPD courses for practising valuers: machinery and equipment; the cost approach to real estate; AI and automated valuation models; residential property; damage from armed aggression; general issues of valuation. Author of, and lecturer on, the eight-hour IIB course on valuing actual loss and lost profits from armed aggression, first delivered on 11 September 2026. In 2026, co-author of the basic qualification programmes for valuers in all three specialisations (real estate, movable property, business).

**Career.**

- Since 2026: Partner, Valuation & Advisory, RSM Ukraine
- 2019–2026: Partner and Valuation & Advisory Leader; Director of the group’s valuation company, Nexia DK (Kyiv and Lviv)
- 2006–2019: Partner, Valuation Services, Nexia DK Auditors & Consultants
- 2001–2006: Head of Valuation Services, Solomon-Group, Kyiv
- 2000–2001: Valuer, Rielter-Ukraine, Kyiv (before the valuer qualification of April 2001)

## Notes

Short answers to practice questions, with the paragraph of each standard or law cited under every claim.

- [Is market value the same as fair value under IFRS 13?](https://nagul.com.ua/en/notes/market-value-vs-fair-value/): 2026-10-08; IFRS 13, IVS 2025, EVS 2025 (EVGN 5), the RICS Red Book and Ukraine's National Valuation Standard No. 1; where the two bases coincide, where they can differ, and what to agree with the valuer for IFRS 13 disclosures
- [Чи дорівнює ринкова вартість справедливій вартості за МСФЗ 13?](https://nagul.com.ua/notes/market-value-vs-fair-value/): the same note in Ukrainian
- [Can a valuer use AI under IVS and EVS?](https://nagul.com.ua/en/notes/ai-and-professional-judgement/): 2026-10-08; IVS 2025, EVS 2025, the RICS Red Book and the RICS standard on responsible use of AI; the line drawn at the valuer's professional judgement, the IVS 2028 draft, and disclosing AI under Ukraine's National Valuation Standard No. 1
- [Чи може оцінювач використовувати ШІ за МСО та ЄСО?](https://nagul.com.ua/notes/ai-and-professional-judgement/): the same note in Ukrainian
- [What does an auditor expect from a review of a valuation report?](https://nagul.com.ua/en/notes/valuation-review-for-auditors/): 2026-10-08; ISA 500, ISA 540 (Revised) and ISA 620 alongside a review under Ukraine's National Valuation Standard No. 1; where the requirements differ and what to agree before work starts
- [Чого аудитор очікує від рецензії на звіт про оцінку?](https://nagul.com.ua/notes/valuation-review-for-auditors/): the same note in Ukrainian
